profile.reading: This is Citigroups Southwest Data Center at 931 Litsey Road in Roanoke, Texas, a facility this registrys coordinate check placed at or very near the operating entity Citigroup Technology Inc, matching this rows tag. The facility was built in 2005, and as of a 2017 disclosure was reported about 50 percent powered by renewable energy purchased from MP2 Energy. In 2023, Citigroup invested about 500,000 dollars at this site converting existing battery rooms into data hall and support space, part of a combined 1 million dollar investment split evenly between this facility and Citigroups other major Texas data center, a 304,700 square foot, LEED Gold certified facility at 201 Blue Ridge Drive in Georgetown, Texas built in 2008, where the matching 500,000 dollar portion instead fitted out existing equipment rooms; that project ran from March to December 2023. Neither facilitys megawatt capacity nor total square footage is publicly disclosed in sources checked this session, consistent with the more limited public disclosure typical of large banks internal enterprise data centers, which Citigroup and peers generally treat as sensitive infrastructure. Citigroup consolidated its global data center footprint from roughly 70 facilities down to about 20 by 2012, according to trade press coverage, reflecting a broader industry wide consolidation trend among large financial institutions during that period. Roanoke, Texas sits in the Dallas-Fort Worth metropolitan area, straddling the Denton and Tarrant county line, and has become a notable draw for large corporate and financial services data centers thanks to relatively affordable land and Texas favorable business tax environment, the same broader regional pull that drew Charles Schwabs headquarters campus and a Cisco data center to nearby sites also tracked in this registry. Citigroup itself traces its roots to Citibank, founded in 1812 in New York as the City Bank of New York, and grew through the 20th and 21st centuries into one of the largest financial services companies in the United States, today known as Citigroup following its 1998 merger with Travelers Group.

This rows coordinates (33.0064, -97.2453, Denton County) closely match the 931 Litsey Road, Roanoke address reported by Data Center Dynamics, though that source lists the county as Tarrant rather than Denton; Roanoke straddles both counties, noted honestly rather than asserted with false precision. This is a considerably better address match than an initial hypothesis of Citigroups Irving, TX technology campus, which was discarded after checking this rows actual coordinates.

reading.body:
This facility is a private corporate data center operated by Citigroup Technology, located in Denton County, Texas. No power capacity, square footage, or IT specifications are published. The operator's corporate locations page does not list this address, and no independent source confirms the facility's presence or specifications. Without published figures, its role in AI infrastructure cannot be evaluated.

Texas hosts 133 mapped data center facilities, of which 18 publish power capacity totaling 468 megawatts. This facility is ranked 19th by published megawatts in the state, meaning it either publishes no figure or publishes less than the 18th-ranked facility. It does not appear in the set of facilities with disclosed power specifications.

The absence of public specifications is consistent with this being an internal corporate facility operated for Citigroup's own use rather than a marketed colocation or cloud platform. Without access to power, cooling, or IT load data, this campus cannot be assessed as a constraint on, or contributor to, AI scaling.
